description: Scans text you supply (an agent's system prompt, tool descriptions, manifest, or output it produced) for prompt-injection and content-trap patterns (OWASP ASI01), using the same deterministic scanner as the full audit. It does not send probes to the agent; for an attested ASI01-10 audit use security.massat-audit. (x402: $0.50 USDC per call)
name: security.injection-resilience
